evidence_scope: Original publisher/proceedings, university and PubMed records; abstract-level crosswalk. No complete article full-text review or global saturation.
prior_art_overlap: Bayesian design, committee query and information-gain work are established prior art; the RVD-specific ethical risk classification is a project application, not a new optimal-design theorem.
special_notice: Model outputs, costs, prior and danger labels in the accompanying code are invented and conditional; no real unsafe agent detected.

records.title: On a Measure of the Information Provided by an Experiment

records.boundary: Information by itself is not voluntary coexistence or correct safety decision

records.title: Discrimination Among Mechanistic Models
